name: loomaly
description: Fix your site's SEO from Codex: what to fix first on every page, a fix prompt for your framework, and a re-check once it's live.

interface.shortDescription: What to fix first on every page of your site, fixed in your repo and re-checked once it's live.
interface.longDescription: Loomaly checks every page of your site and ranks its SEO problems by what to fix first. For each problem Codex gets the evidence and a fix prompt written for your framework, makes the change in your repo, records the fix, and once it's deployed asks Loomaly to re-check the live page. Sign in with a Loomaly account; the free plan covers one site.
defaultPrompt: Use Loomaly to find what to fix first on my site.
Use Loomaly to fix the top SEO problem on my site in this repo.
